description: A revered pilgrimage site in Rajasthan dedicated to Gogaji Maharaj, also known as Jahar Veer Gogaji. Thousands of devotees visit the shrine every year seeking protection from snake bites, blessings, and fulfillment of their wishes. story: Bagad Guga Madi is one of the most sacred places associated with Gogaji Maharaj, also known as Jahar Veer Gogaji. According to local tradition, Gogaji was a brave Rajput warrior and a revered folk deity blessed with divine powers over snakes. It is believed that those who pray here with faith receive protection from snake bites and relief from hardships. Every year, during the Bhadrapada month, a grand fair is organized where devotees from Rajasthan, Haryana, Punjab, and other parts of India gather to offer prayers, sing devotional songs, and participate in religious processions. The shrine symbolizes courage, faith, communal harmony, and centuries-old cultural traditions.
